channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Study reveals brain's information hub flexibility
item.description: Researchers found the frontoparietal cortex adapts to uncertainty and changing conditions, highlighting the brain's flexible processing system.

item.title: MIT discovers electrons self-organize like ice in quantum material
item.description: MIT physicists observed two electronic phases in a quantum material emerging via distinct mechanisms—one gradual, the other abrupt.

item.title: Quantum engines tap into energy from waste heat
item.description: A machine built from a single atom and light particles raises a key question about extracting useful energy from waste heat.

item.title: Coffee linked to lower fat, higher muscle, and hormone shifts
item.description: A Finnish study found that higher coffee consumption was associated with less total and abdominal fat, more muscle, and notable hormone differences.
